procedureOverview.title: Our Execution Procedure
procedureOverview.subtitle: Right after clients get on board, we follow a formal process through which we execute & complete projects.

steps.name: Brainstorming
steps.text: A roadmap & strategy is provided to the client after a brainstorming session between the managing directors, creative head, strategist & content writer. The strategy highlights the methods which will be used to reach the goal that client wants for their business.

steps.name: Content
steps.text: The content writer prepares a content calendar for posts that will be created for client's social media. This includes engaging posts, messaging posts, ad posts & brand-building posts which enables us to position the business in audience's minds.

steps.name: Approval
steps.text: Thirdly, the content prepared is sent to the client for approval. If the client approves then it is forwarded to the creative team for graphics. Otherwise, the content is revised according to client demands & forwarded to creative team later after approval.

steps.name: Creative Team
steps.text: This team consists of graphic designers who are highly skilled in their work. They design & create each post which is first approved by client then sent to execution team for uploading. This team is equipped with high-end systems creative tools to meet their needs.

steps.name: Execution
steps.text: The execution team uploads all content after client's approval. They optimize it using relevant hashtags to reach more audiences, and captions are added on posts focused to engage audience as much as possible.

terms.title: Our Working Engagement Terms
terms.subtitle: By engaging with Coherence Visual, you agree to our transparent operating principles:

items.detail: We provide branding, social media marketing, video production, website development, SEO, digital marketing, and graphic design. The scope is agreed upon before commencement.
A deposit may be required before work begins. Full payment is due before final delivery.
Limited revisions are included as per the agreement. Additional revisions or major scope changes may be subject to extra charges.
Coherence Visual retains ownership of all concepts until full payment. After payment, final deliverables belong to the client.
Clients must provide necessary content, materials, and approvals on time to ensure target timelines are met.
Both parties agree to keep all shared business information strictly confidential.
